description: This file defines a React functional component for a user interface that provides a modal form to add pass-through (proxy) endpoints. It includes form fields for route configuration, security, headers, guardrails, and billing, and manages creation of endpoints via API calls.

classes.name: AddPassThroughEndpoint
classes.description: React functional component for adding pass-through endpoints via a modal form

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form fields and state variables, and closes the modal

methods.name: handlePathChange
methods.description: Formats and updates the path prefix input

methods.name: addPassThrough
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new pass-through endpoint and update the parent state

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to the system clipboard
